LanguageData.RK_Storyteller_RottyMilden.label: Rotty Milden
LanguageData.RK_Storyteller_RottyMilden.description:
Rotty Milden tells stories shaped by the life of a spirited country girl. You will grow with a new village, meet unfamiliar faces, and watch the settlement grow livelier as traders and travelers pass through. 

Her little pranks keep the story from going dull, though now and then they may stir up unexpectedly large trouble.

Major threats are less frequent, while visits, trade, encounters on the road, and news of new companions joining happen more often.
